description: Matrix Planner is a Power BI visual designed to empower users with a streamlined approach to planning, forecasting, budgeting, and financial reporting directly within Power BI. The visual enables the seamless integration of operational reporting and financial planning within the same tool, maximizing the potential of Power BI data models. With this Power BI visual, you can effortlessly writeback your data and process your semantic models or analysis services cubes directly within Power BI. As changes are made to the database, the visual will refresh automatically ensuring a unified and optimal experience for financial planning and operational reporting. Features: Writeback capability Distributes values ​​to descendants using one of three operations (Replace/Uniform/Relative) Cell Formulas Filter other visuals with row/column selections Aggregate calculations (Sum/Average) Expand/Collapse Rows Write-Security measure Read-only measures Show/Hide columns and rows subtotals Switch measures to rows Benefits: Ability to change data in SQL tables through Power BI Use Direct Query or Import Mode Process semantic models or analysis services cubes Build, optimize and monitor business process planning Matrix Planner is available for download on Power BI through Microsoft AppSource.
